args.body:
• Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a blog article on the topic and inviting readers to a related webinar (seat held via personalized link).
• Article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
• Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter summary — Retail returns logistics
